description: Generate a high-quality video world from a text prompt with the Cosmos Predict 14B model.
inputInstructions: Provide the generation prompt via the COSMOS_PREDICT_PROMPT asset metadata key (or PROMPT in the config). DISABLE_GUARDRAILS toggles the model guardrails, GENERATE_PREVIEW_GIF=true also emits a preview GIF of the result, and the OFFLOAD_* flags trade inference speed for GPU memory. The model type and size are fixed by the registered pipeline.
